set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols isis level 1.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

wide-metrics-only.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

parameters.name: interval

parameters.name: delay
parameters.explanation: SPF计算的延迟时间，单位为毫秒。

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: Level of ISIS agreement, 2 indicates level 2.

point-to-point.explanation: Configure the interface type of the IS-IS protocol as a point-to-point.

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/2.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

point-to-point.explanation: Configure the interface type of the IS-IS protocol as a point-to-point.
